svg.title: Forest Service / British Columbia — white-band tree oval
svg.desc: Clean geometry is interpreted from the supplied source; it is not an authenticated production master. Replacement outlined fonts approximate stitched/painted lettering; camera perspective, stitch texture and uncertain fine detail are not reproduced. Colors are selected from visual reference, without color calibration. Tree/landscape charges use shared forestoval vector art and designed scenery fitted to this specimen, rather than its embroidery edge contours.
